target_zip.description: Path to the target zip archive that will receive the merged content.

sources.description: List of source zip archive paths to merge into the target archive.

ignore_directories.description: If true, passes -D to zipmerge to ignore directory components in file name comparisons.

ignore_case.description: If true, passes -I to zipmerge to ignore case in file name comparisons.

ask_before_overwrite.description: If true, passes -i to zipmerge to ask before overwriting files.

keep_uncompressed.description: If true, passes -k to zipmerge to do not compress files that were uncompressed in source-zip.

skip_identical.description: If true, passes -S to zipmerge to do not overwrite files that have the same name, size, and CRC32.

skip_identical_quiet.description: If true, passes -s to zipmerge to not ask before overwriting files that have the same name, size, and CRC32 when -i is given.
